name: c0-grid-overnight-baseline
description: Locked profile for 1920×1080 landscape VODs, hot-switch audio (no blips on quadrant change), feed-failure benching, and auto-pilot overnight. Apply when grid is OFF: bash scripts/live_grid_baseline.sh apply
featuresLocked: END STREAM posts endBroadcast:true — encoder + YouTube listing both end
Dashboard quadrant click uses listen (auto-pilot stays on); only pin:true or chat !listen pins manual
Auto-audio skips unhealthy quads (relay restarts + feed failures)
Feed guard: 5 streamlink failures / 2min → bench quadrant + move audio off
Resume state does not restore stale manual audio without pinSource
RTMP landscape guard blocks GO LIVE if YOUTUBE_SQUARE_PAD would send 1080×1080
On-stream AUDIO badge (top-right of on-air quad) + CLIPZ WORLD LIVE frame bug
Poller auto-fills empty quadrants from bench when operator mode off (overnight auto-pilot)
codeLocked: compositor.js: YOUTUBE_SQUARE_PAD default off; RTMP gets -s 1920x1080 -aspect 16:9
compositor.js: LIVE_GRID_CELL_FIT default letterbox (matches jC7G-era VODs)
compositor.js: volume@aqN hot-switch amix when AUDIO_COPY=off (no master restart on audio hop)
live_routes.js: /live-grid/audio listen vs pin; stop endBroadcast
doNotRevertWithoutReason: LIVE_GRID_YOUTUBE_SQUARE_PAD=on (RTMP becomes 1080×1080 while HLS stays 16:9 — bad VODs)
LIVE_GRID_CELL_FIT=cover without testing (changes cell crop vs jC7G VODs)
live_routes audio default manual (pins auto-pilot overnight)
Skipping endBroadcast on dashboard END STREAM (zombie YouTube LIVE)

overnightAutoPilot.operatorMode: off for bench auto-fill and viewer swaps
overnightAutoPilot.audioMode: auto — dashboard clicks use listen, not manual pin
overnightAutoPilot.resume: does not restore manual pin without audioPinSource
overnightAutoPilot.feedGuard: auto-bench Q1 event feeds after repeated streamlink exits

probeBaseline.command: ffmpeg -hide_banner -loglevel error -i http://127.0.0.1:3000/broadcast/preview-hls/index.m3u8 -t 10 -vn -af silencedetect=noise=-38dB:d=0.06 -f null - 2>&1 | grep -c silence_end || true
